why_ai: Unlicensed remote research whose interviewing and synthesis AI increasingly performs, and the first budget cut.
why_clarity: Methods are established, but whether findings were right is checked almost nowhere.
why_digital: Remote sessions with users in, reports and highlight reels out, bought remotely.

why_ai: Transcription, coding and clustering of interviews are mechanical layers AI now automates.
why_clarity: Every study needs synthesis, but what counts as a good finding is interpretive and unchecked.
why_digital: Transcripts and recordings in, findings decks out.

why_ai: Writing studies up for later retrieval is a workflow and incentive problem AI write-ups can absorb.
why_clarity: Every study should be curated, but no agreed standard defines retrievable enough.
why_digital: Study material written into a digital repository.

why_ai: Screeners, guides, recording and consent setup repeat from the last study and automate fully.
why_clarity: Identical setup steps per study with an instant check: in field or not.
why_digital: Screeners, links and recordings configured entirely online.

why_ai: Fraud detection against professional participants is adversarial but a classic automated detection problem.
why_clarity: Whether each participant is genuine is a defined check repeated on every recruit.
why_digital: Screener answers and identity signals checked online.

why_ai: Capturing predictions and checking them against outcomes is a records and analytics task.
why_clarity: Predictions are testable, but outcome data arrives late from client systems.
why_digital: Reports and client product data, handled entirely as data.

why_ai: Decks, clips and summaries generated from existing analysis are direct AI substitutes.
why_clarity: The same deliverable structure is rebuilt every study from existing material.
why_digital: Analysis in, slides and video reels out.

why_ai: Answering design questions from stored transcripts is exactly what retrieval-augmented AI does.
why_clarity: Queries recur, but answer usefulness depends on how well material was curated.
why_digital: Digital transcripts and findings searched on screens.

why_ai: Synthesis over an existing corpus is a retrieval problem LLMs solve without habit change.
why_clarity: Questions recur, though usable answers to design questions are judged subjectively.
why_digital: Existing digital corpus in, synthesised answers out.

why_ai: Studies still need real humans, so matching, payment and reputation for participants keep value.
why_clarity: Participation recurs constantly, but what serves participants is loosely defined.
why_digital: Participants are recruited, paid and run through online panels.

why_ai: Participant pipelines, consent and incentive payments are routine admin built for automation.
why_clarity: Each study runs the same pipeline steps and breakage is immediately visible.
why_digital: Spreadsheets, consent forms and payments run online, with occasional room bookings.
